headline: Questions, quietly answered.
footer_note: Didn't find it? More info drops closer to the gate — we'll announce on the 2026 Spotify playlist and inside the ticket confirmation.

items.question: When do tickets go on sale?
items.answer: General tickets are on sale now. Inner Circle passes drop in waves — we announce each release on our newsletter 48 hours prior.

items.question: Is the festival all-ages?
items.answer: Yes. Under-18s must be accompanied by a legal guardian after 9pm. Valid ID required for the 21+ bar. The main floor is step-free.

items.question: What about re-entry, bags and food?
items.answer: Re-entry is allowed until 10pm with your wristband. Small bags (12" × 12") are welcome. Six food trucks, vegan options at each. No outside food or drink.

items.question: How does the payment plan work?
items.answer: At checkout you can split any ticket into three interest-free payments via Klarna or Affirm. Last instalment must clear by 10.18.25.

items.question: Can I transfer my ticket?
items.answer: Yes — through our official ticketing partner until seven days before the festival. After that, tickets are name-locked.

items.question: What happens if it rains?
items.answer: The festival is indoor across all three stages. Rain or shine, Desert Grey happens. Flash-flood warning? Check our channels for updates.
